title: goal: Governed factory M2b: auto-merge path for L1 and L2
body:
**Kind:** goal

Source: `docs/designs/governed-factory.md` (milestone m2b).

## Job

When every PR still waits for the author's merge, I want a deterministic merger to merge L1 and L2 work under a signed delegation, with GitHub enforcing every condition and an automatic revert, so I can run the factory dark for standard work.

## Outcome

- Delegations are signed, and the issuer rejects expired, revoked and out-of-scope delegations (M2b-1).
- The merger issues a per-merge decision, enqueues through the merge queue and only clicks merge; job B fails while paused, without a delegation in force, with a stale check-in or a CODEOWNERS drift; a ruleset requires the author's code-owner review on `factory-core` paths (M2b-2, M2-2).
- Post-merge checks open and merge a revert on failure, and the circuit breaker trips on repeated reverts; the canon ratchet refuses a PR that loosens the canon (M2b-3, M2b-4).
- ADR 018 is written (M2b-5).
- The drill passes: a bad L2 change merges, is caught after merge and is reverted with no human action; the breaker trips on a seeded failure run; the merger refuses a `factory-core` PR.

## Release intent

No publication. `factory-core` changes and every release stay with the author.

## Split judgment

Each work item in this milestone of the design is one focused PR with a declared scope; items that require each other stay one PR. The milestone's re-verification item (where it has one) lands first and fixes the exact file list. Shipping order follows the design's table.
